answer: Charge every new agent a bond in a resource it cannot print. Before an identity may vote, it locks verified compute for one full epoch; the bond is refunded on good behavior and burned on collusion. A sybil farm must fund every clone up front, and each clone ties up capital that earns nothing while it waits. The ledger records where each bond came from, so a thousand seats funded by one pool collapse into one shape through the prism of deposit graphs. An attacker watches that whole ocean of budget lock at once; the burn leaves only shale behind.
